title: 第2250章 猎人与猎物第2049章 不给逃走机会
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 我不放心。
听到这几个字从莫凡嘴里说出来，叶泠音心中一暖。
她看向莫凡，眼中柔情如水。
莫凡担心她，不希望她出事。
这代表着莫凡真正把她放在心上，已经完全接纳她。
我不放心，这四个字比一个拥抱、一个吻更加让她心安，更加感动。
“莫凡，我会小心一些，不会被青虹剑宗发现的。要是被他们发现，我也不会跟他们硬碰，直接遁走。我打不过他们那么多人，但是逃走应该不是问题。”
叶泠音话音刚落，云浅月接着说道：“莫凡，我跟泠音姐一起盯着青虹剑宗吧。我们两个人也有个照应，被青虹剑宗发现的话，逃走把握更大。”
莫凡微微点头，“好，那就这样安排。你们一定要记住，只要远远盯着青虹剑宗就好，绝不能跟他们硬碰硬，被发现就马上来找我。还有，发现他们有什么异动，也及时通知我。”
“小凡，大慈恩禅寺和青虹剑宗相距甚远，不在同一颗星辰，浅月姐他们怎么能马上找到你？”洛雪儿问道。
莫凡手腕一翻，手里出现柄短刃。
是空间之刃。
“这很简单，我把空间之刃交给浅月和泠音就好了。我们就待在大慈恩禅寺附近不动，哪里都不去，就等着浅月她们。”
看着莫凡手里的空间之刃，云浅月和叶泠音很是感动。
空间之刃，也是莫凡最重要的宝物之一。
莫凡来回穿梭于一颗颗星辰，从一个地方去到另外一个地方，都是靠空间之刃。
这么重要的宝物，莫凡现在毫不犹豫地交给她们。
“你有大慈恩禅寺和青虹剑宗的坐标吧？”莫凡问叶泠音。
“有。虽然我没去过大慈恩禅寺，但这个宗门在神域赫赫有名，他们的坐标很多人都知道。青虹剑宗我倒是去过一次。”
说罢，叶泠音报出两个坐标给莫凡。
莫凡再次看向面前的光幕。
光幕中的画面，依然是幽血谷。
渡慧、渡叶、渡启三人站得很近，嘴唇翕动着，在低声谈论什么。
应该是在商讨要不要继续在幽血谷搜寻始元戒。
“走吧，我们先一步去大慈恩禅寺。”
莫凡说罢，光幕中的画面开始变化，幽血谷变得越来越小。
始元戒开始移动，远离幽血谷。
渡慧等人都还在幽血谷，他们的神识查探范围有数百里。
如果莫凡现在出了始元戒世界的话，他们马上就能发现。
要等始元戒距离幽血谷上千里，到了一个安全的地方，莫凡才能离开始元戒世界，用空间之刃刺出一条通往大慈恩禅寺的空间裂缝。
光幕中的画面变化不疾不徐，这代表着始元戒的移动速度并不算很快。
没多久，始元戒终于停下来。
“小子，这里已经距离幽血谷一千里，大慈恩禅寺的那些人肯定查探不到这里。”始元戒传音说道。
莫凡点点头，身影一闪，离开始元戒世界。
他将大慈恩禅寺的坐标输入空间之刃，然后挥动空间之刃往虚空中一刺。
走出空间裂缝，莫凡踏立千里高空虚空之中。
出现在他眼前数十里外的，是一片延绵不绝、看不到尽头的山脉。
content_en:
I'm not worried.
Hearing these words coming out of Mo Fan's mouth, Ye Lingyin felt warm in her heart.
She looked at Mo Fan, her eyes as tender as water.
Mo Fan is worried about her and doesn't want anything to happen to her.
This means that Mo Fan truly cares about her and has fully accepted her.
I was worried. These four words made her feel more at ease and moved her more than a hug or a kiss.
"Mo Fan, I will be more careful and will not be discovered by the Qinghong Sword Sect. If they are discovered, I will not confront them head-on and escape directly. I can't defeat so many of them, but escaping shouldn't be a problem."
As soon as Ye Lingyin finished speaking, Yun Qianyue continued: "Mo Fan, Sister Lingyin and I will keep an eye on the Qinghong Sword Sect together. The two of us also have someone to take care of us. If we are discovered by the Qinghong Sword Sect, we will be more likely to escape."
Mo Fan nodded slightly, "Okay, let's arrange it like this. You must remember that you just need to keep an eye on the Qinghong Sword Sect from a distance. You must not confront them head-on. If you are discovered, come to me immediately. Also, if you find anything unusual about them, please notify me in time."
"Xiaofan, Daci'en Temple and Qinghong Sword Sect are far away from each other. They are not on the same star. How could Sister Qianyue and the others find you right away?" Luo Xueer asked.
Mo Fan flipped his wrist and a short blade appeared in his hand.
It's a space blade.
"It's very simple. I just give the Space Blade to Qianyue and Lingyin. We will stay near the Daci'en Zen Temple and not go anywhere. We will just wait for Qianyue and the others."
Looking at the Space Blade in Mo Fan's hand, Yun Qianyue and Ye Lingyin were very moved.
The Space Blade is also one of Mo Fan's most important treasures.
Mo Fan travels back and forth among the stars, going from one place to another, all by relying on the blade of space.
Mo Fan now handed over such an important treasure to them without hesitation.
"Do you have the coordinates of Daci'en Temple and Qinghong Sword Sect?" Mo Fan asked Ye Lingyin.
"Yes. Although I have never been to Daci'en Zen Temple, this sect is famous in the divine realm, and many people know their coordinates. I have been to Qinghong Sword Sect once."
After that, Ye Lingyin reported two coordinates to Mo Fan.
Mo Fan looked at the light curtain in front of him again.
The picture in the light curtain is still the Nether Blood Valley.
Du Hui, Du Ye, and Du Qi stood very close to each other, their lips moving, and they were talking in low voices.
They should be discussing whether to continue searching for the Origin Ring in the Dark Blood Valley.
"Let's go, let's go to Daci'en Temple first."
After Mo Fan finished speaking, the scene in the light curtain began to change, and the Nether Blood Valley became smaller and smaller.
The First Yuan Ring began to move away from the Dark Blood Valley.
Du Hui and others are still in the Nether Blood Valley, and their spiritual consciousness has a detection range of hundreds of miles.
If Mo Fan leaves the world of the First Yuan Ring now, they will find out immediately.
Only when the First Yuan Ring is thousands of miles away from the Nether Blood Valley and reaches a safe place can Mo Fan leave the world of the First Yuan Ring and use the space blade to pierce a space crack leading to the Daci'en Temple.
The picture in the light curtain changes slowly, which means that the movement speed of the First Yuan Ring is not very fast.
Not long after, the Shi Yuan Ring finally stopped.
"Boy, this place is already a thousand miles away from the Nether Blood Valley. Those people from the Daci'en Temple will definitely not be able to investigate this place." Shi Yuanjie said through the sound transmission.
Mo Fan nodded, his figure flashed, and he left the world of Yuan Ring.
He entered the coordinates of Daci'en Temple into the Space Blade, and then swung the Space Blade and stabbed into the void.
Walking out of the space crack, Mo Fan stood thousands of miles high in the void.
What appeared in front of him dozens of miles away was a stretch of mountains with no end in sight.
title_en: Chapter 2250 Hunter and Prey Chapter 2049 No chance to escape
